AI.method: 单例病例报告。患者为44岁男性，右室严重发育不良、既往双向Glenn术后，表现为持续性单形性室速。联合经胸及心腔内超声、CT和高密度电解剖标测重建右心解剖并识别致心律失常基质；将心腔内超声轮廓与电解剖图融合构建残存右室几何。程序刺激未诱发室速，于晚电位区域行起搏标测，以基质均质化为消融策略，术后高密度重标测评估晚电位是否消除。摘要未报告统计方法。
AI.result: 残存右室可见广泛低电压区，最晚且最碎裂的晚电位局限于右室流出道前部。程序刺激未诱发室速；晚电位区域起搏标测复制出临床QRS形态，刺激-QRS间期为153毫秒。以基质均质化为导向消融，术后高密度重标测证实所有晚电位均被消除。出院前植入皮下ICD。摘要未报告随访结局。
AI.conclusion: 本例提示，在单心室生理合并右室发育不良及Glenn术后患者中，多模态影像与心腔内超声-电解剖图融合有助于复杂右心解剖重建和基质定位；当室速不可诱发时，可依据晚电位和起搏标测行基质均质化消融，并以皮下ICD作为器械治疗。结论受限于单例报告，缺乏随访和统计比较，可推广性有限。

title: Four Distinct Morphologies of Bundle Branch Reentrant Ventricular Tachycardia Eliminated by Right Bundle Branch Ablation.
Delayed left ventricular remodelling in patients with heart failure and reduced ejection fraction: a systematic review.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: Guidelines recommend an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) in patients with heart failure and a left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) of 35% or less despite at least 3 months of guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) to reduce the risk of sudden cardiac death (SCD). However, more efficacious contemporary GDMT may be associated with improvements in LVEF beyond 3 months.

METHODS: A systematic review of MEDLINE, Embase, Cumulative Index to Nursing and Allied Health Literature, Cochrane Trials, the Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews and Web of Science was conducted. Studies of patients with an LVEF of 35% or less after at least 3 months of GDMT who were treated with a longer duration of GDMT were included. Risk of bias was evaluated using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale and a narrative synthesis presented. We report rates of LVEF improvement to above the 35% threshold and all-cause mortality after longer-duration GDMT.

RESULTS: Sixteen observational studies met the inclusion criteria. Risk of bias identified in six of these studies was mainly related to adequacy of follow-up. Risk of bias across other domains and in the other studies was low. Four studies reported the temporal change in ICD eligibility. Following 3–6 months additional GDMT, there was an improvement in LVEF to above 35% in 21%–59% of participants. Three studies reported higher proportions of participants with an LVEF above 35% with increasing duration of GDMT. Seven studies reported all-cause mortality, ranging from 0% to 7.6% during follow-up of 6–24 months.

CONCLUSION: In patients with heart failure and an LVEF of 35% or less despite at least 3 months of GDMT, two to six in 10 patients demonstrated an improvement in their LVEF to >35% after a further 3–6 months of GDMT. During this period, mortality rates were low. A longer period of GDMT prior to evaluation for ICD may be appropriate.

PROSPERO REGISTRATION NUMBER: CRD42023390835.

AI.tldr: 在接受至少3个月指南导向药物治疗（GDMT）后LVEF仍≤35%的射血分数降低心衰患者中，再延长3–6个月GDMT可使约20%–60%患者LVEF改善至35%以上，且该期间全因死亡率仅0%–7.6%，提示ICD植入前或可延长药物优化窗口。
AI.motivation: 现行指南建议：在至少3个月GDMT后LVEF仍≤35%的心衰患者中植入ICD以降低心脏性猝死风险。但这一3个月的时间阈值源自较早年代的药物证据，当代更有效的GDMT（如ARNI、SGLT2抑制剂等）可能带来更晚、更持续的LVEF改善，导致部分患者在植入ICD后LVEF才回升至35%以上，从而造成ICD适应证判断过早、器械使用不当。目前的证据缺口是：缺乏对“延长GDMT后LVEF逆转比例及同期死亡率”的系统汇总。
AI.method: 系统综述，检索MEDLINE、Embase、CINAHL、Cochrane Trials、Cochrane系统综述数据库及Web of Science，并在PROSPERO注册（CRD42023390835）。纳入标准为：LVEF≤35%、已接受至少3个月GDMT、随后继续延长GDMT疗程的观察性研究。采用纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表评估偏倚风险，行叙述性综合。主要观察指标为LVEF改善至35%以上的比例，次要指标为全因死亡率。
AI.result: 共纳入16项观察性研究。6项研究存在偏倚风险，主要涉及随访的充分性，其余研究及其他偏倚域风险较低。4项研究报告了ICD适应资格随时间的变化：额外3–6个月GDMT后，21%–59%的受试者LVEF改善至35%以上。3项研究显示，随着GDMT疗程延长，LVEF>35%的受试者比例进一步升高。7项研究报告了全因死亡率，随访6–24个月期间为0%–7.6%。摘要未报告LVEF改善的预测因素、具体效应量的95%CI及P值。
AI.conclusion: 在接受至少3个月GDMT后LVEF仍≤35%的心衰患者中，约每10人中有2–6人在再延长3–6个月GDMT后LVEF回升至35%以上，且该期间死亡率较低（0%–7.6%）。提示在评估ICD植入前给予更长的GDMT优化期可能是合理的，可避免对LVEF可逆患者过度植入ICD。局限性：证据全部来自观察性研究，样本量与随访时长有限，缺乏随机对照验证，且未明确哪些患者应延长等待、延长多久，尚不能据此直接修改现行ICD适应证流程。

title: Out of sight, not out of risk: laser extraction of a 26-year-old abandoned pacemaker lead guided by multimodal imaging.
Appropriate ICD Therapies in Primary Prevention: A Propensity-Matched Comparison of Contemporary and Historic Heart Failure Cohorts
summary: Background In heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), a substantial proportion of deaths are arrhythmic. Implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs) are recommended for primary prevention in patients with left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≤ 35% despite guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT), but landmark trials predate widespread use of angiotensin receptor-neprilysin inhibitors (ARNI) and sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2i), raising uncertainty about arrhythmic risk in the contemporary treatment era.Methods We retrospectively studied consecutive HFrEF patients undergoing primary-prevention ICD implantation at a single center (2015-2022), categorized into historical-era and contemporary-era cohorts by ARNI/SGLT2i adoption. Propensity-score matching balanced baseline characteristics. The primary endpoint was time to first appropriate ICD therapy (antitachycardia pacing or shock).Results Of 289 patients (mean age 62 ± 11 years, 82% male), 234 (117 per group) remained after matching. Mean follow-up was 51 months. Appropriate ICD therapy incidence did not differ significantly between contemporary-era and historical-era cohorts (hazard ratio [HR] 1.52, 95% CI 0.84-2.72; p = 0.165). Competing-risk-adjusted cumulative incidence was numerically higher in the contemporary-era cohort at a pre-specified 36-months horizon, consistent with a sensitivity analysis using an expanded propensity-score model (HR 1.55, 95% CI 0.82-2.94).Conclusion ICD therapy rates were not significantly different between the contemporary-era and historical-era cohorts, a finding robust to sensitivity and competing-risk analyses. These results should be interpreted cautiously, as the study may be underpowered to detect modest differences, and clinically relevant effects cannot be excluded.

AI.tldr: 在经倾向评分匹配的289例HFrEF一级预防ICD患者中，采用ARNI/SGLT2i的当代队列与历史队列的恰当ICD治疗发生率无显著差异（HR 1.52，95%CI 0.84-2.72，P=0.165）。
AI.motivation: HFrEF患者中相当比例的死因为心律失常性，指南推荐对经指南导向药物治疗（GDMT）后LVEF仍≤35%的患者植入ICD进行一级预防。然而支持该推荐的里程碑试验开展于ARNI与SGLT2i广泛应用之前，在当代药物治疗背景下，心律失常风险是否发生变化、ICD一级预防的绝对获益是否被削弱，仍缺乏直接比较证据。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列研究，连续纳入2015-2022年接受一级预防ICD植入的HFrEF患者289例（平均年龄62±11岁，男性82%），按ARNI/SGLT2i的实际采用情况划分为历史队列与当代队列，采用倾向评分匹配平衡基线特征，匹配后234例（每组117例）。主要终点为首次恰当ICD治疗（抗心动过速起搏或电击）的时间；平均随访51个月。统计分析包括Cox比例风险模型、竞争风险校正的累积发生率以及采用扩展倾向评分模型的敏感性分析。
AI.result: 匹配后两组各117例，平均随访51个月。当代队列与历史队列的恰当ICD治疗发生率无显著差异（HR 1.52，95%CI 0.84-2.72，P=0.165）。竞争风险校正后，在预设的36个月时点，当代队列的累积发生率数值上更高；采用扩展倾向评分模型的敏感性分析结果一致（HR 1.55，95%CI 0.82-2.94）。摘要未报告全因死亡、心衰住院等次要终点的具体数据。
AI.conclusion: 在当代GDMT（含ARNI/SGLT2i）背景下，一级预防ICD患者的恰当ICD治疗发生率与历史队列相比无统计学差异，该结果在敏感性与竞争风险分析中保持稳健。但研究为单中心回顾性设计、样本量有限，可能存在把握度不足而无法检出中等程度差异，故不能排除具有临床意义的效应；未来需更大规模、多中心、前瞻性研究验证当代药物治疗时代ICD一级预防的获益人群与风险分层策略。

title: Attractive and repulsive couplings between circadian pacemaker neurons promote entrainment to light-dark cycles with after-effect.
summary: The mammalian circadian pacemaker, the suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN), comprises a core region that receives light signals from the retina and a shell region that outputs pacemaking rhythms to peripheral tissues. The free-running period (FRP) of animals in constant darkness (DD) correlates with the period of the preceding LD cycle, a phenomenon known as after-effect. To elucidate the mechanisms underlying robust entrainment and after-effect, we analyzed phase oscillator models incorporating attractive and repulsive couplings that respectively decrease or increase phase differences between oscillators. Attractive coupling from the core to shell regions accounts for experimentally observed phase relationships between these regions under LD cycles. Remarkably, repulsive coupling from the shell to core regions promotes SCN entrainability to LD cycles. Furthermore, after transfer to DD, the FRP slowly returns to the intrinsic SCN period, reflecting the after-effect. Our analysis identifies an SCN coupling architecture that underlies stable daily activity rhythms.

AI.tldr: 相位振子模型显示，视交叉上核核心区向壳区的吸引性耦合与壳区向核心区的排斥性耦合协同作用，既维持光暗周期下的稳健同步，又解释转入持续黑暗后自由运行周期缓慢回归内在周期的后效应。
AI.motivation: 哺乳动物昼夜节律起搏器视交叉上核（SCN）分为接收视网膜光信号的核心区与向外周组织输出节律的壳区。既往已知动物在持续黑暗（DD）下的自由运行周期（FRP）与前一个光暗（LD）周期的周期长度相关，即“后效应”，但稳健同步与后效应背后的耦合机制尚不清楚，缺乏能同时解释二者的网络架构模型。
AI.method: 本研究为计算神经科学研究，非临床人群研究，无患者入组与样本量（摘要未报告）。作者构建相位振子模型，引入吸引性耦合（减小振子间相位差）与排斥性耦合（增大相位差），设定核心区与壳区之间的双向耦合，在 LD 周期及随后转入 DD 的条件下进行模拟，观察两区相位关系、SCN 对 LD 周期的同步能力（entrainability）以及 FRP 随时间的变化。具体数值分析与统计检验方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 由核心区指向壳区的吸引性耦合能够复现实验中 LD 周期下核心区与壳区之间的相位关系；壳区指向核心区的排斥性耦合可显著增强 SCN 对 LD 周期的同步能力；转入 DD 后，模型中的 FRP 缓慢回归至 SCN 内在周期，重现后效应现象。摘要未报告效应量、95% 置信区间及 P 值等定量统计结果。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出一种 SCN 耦合架构——核心→壳区吸引性耦合与壳→核心排斥性耦合并存——可同时解释稳定的日常节律同步与后效应。该结论为昼夜节律网络动力学提供机制假设，对电生理实践的直接指导有限，但可为心律失常与器械治疗的时间生物学问题（如夜间事件分布、按节律给药的 chronotherapy）提供上游机制线索；局限性在于纯计算模型、缺乏实验与人体数据验证，且未报告定量统计指标。

title: Cardiac Magnetic Resonance-derived Ablation Footprint after Sequential Unipolar Radiofrequency, Focal Pulsed Field, and Bipolar Radiofrequency Ablation of Resistant Left Ventricular Summit VT.
Histone lysine demethylase inhibition is a disease-modifying therapy for hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
summary:
RATIONALE: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is a common inherited cardiac disorder characterized by cardiac hypertrophy, fibrosis, arrhythmias, and sudden cardiac death (SCD). Although current therapies primarily target sarcomere dysfunction, the contribution of epigenetic dysregulation to HCM pathogenesis and its therapeutic potential remain poorly understood.

OBJECTIVE: To determine whether pharmacological inhibition of histone lysine demethylases (KDMs) with JIB-04 can prevent or reverse HCM progression and to identify the underlying epigenetic mechanisms.

METHODS AND RESULTS: We evaluated the pan-KDM inhibitor JIB-04 in Myh6 R403Q/+ mice carrying the murine equivalent of the pathogenic human MYH7 R403Q mutation. JIB-04 prevented disease progression, reduced cardiac hypertrophy and fibrosis, preserved cardiac function, and completely prevented SCD in cyclosporin A- accelerated HCM. JIB-04 also reversed established disease, produced sustained therapeutic benefits after drug withdrawal, and improved cardiac function in aged mice with spontaneous HCM. Bulk RNA sequencing and ATAC-seq demonstrated partial restoration of disease-associated transcriptional programs and chromatin accessibility. Proteomic analyses identified PHF2 (KDM7C) as a candidate target of JIB-04 in both mouse and human HCM hearts. PHF2 knockdown suppressed hypertrophic, inflammatory, and fibrotic gene expression in cardiomyocytes, macrophages, and fibroblasts, respectively. Human HCM hearts exhibited increased expression of multiple JIB-04-sensitive KDMs, including PHF2. In MYH7 R403Q induced pluripotent stem cell- derived cardiomyocytes, JIB-04 normalized disease-associated gene expression, restored connexin-43 membrane localization, and improved mitochondrial respiration. Although prolonged treatment induced reversible hepatomegaly with hepatic lipid accumulation, co-administration of the antioxidant N-acetylcysteine mitigated liver toxicity while preserving the therapeutic efficacy of JIB-04.

CONCLUSIONS: Pharmacological KDM inhibition prevents and reverses HCM through epigenetic remodeling of disease-associated transcriptional and chromatin programs. These findings identify KDM inhibition as a promising therapeutic strategy for HCM, establish PHF2 as a candidate mediator of disease pathogenesis, and support further development of KDM-targeted therapies.

AI.tldr: 在 Myh6 R403Q/+ HCM 小鼠中，泛 KDM 抑制剂 JIB-04 可阻止并逆转心肌肥厚、纤维化与心功能下降，完全预防猝死，并提示 PHF2 为候选靶点。
AI.motivation: 肥厚型心肌病（HCM）是常见的遗传性心脏病，表现为心肌肥厚、纤维化、心律失常和猝死（SCD）。现有治疗主要针对肌节功能障碍，表观遗传失调在 HCM 发病中的作用及其治疗潜力尚不清楚。
AI.method: 临床前研究。研究对象为携带人 MYH7 R403Q 致病突变小鼠等效位点的 Myh6 R403Q/+ 小鼠、老龄自发 HCM 小鼠、人 HCM 心脏样本及 MYH7 R403Q iPSC 来源心肌细胞；干预为泛组蛋白赖氨酸去甲基化酶（KDM）抑制剂 JIB-04。主要终点包括 HCM 疾病进展、心肌肥厚与纤维化、心功能及环孢素 A 加速模型中的 SCD；机制终点包括 RNA-seq、ATAC-seq、蛋白组、PHF2 靶点及 iPSC-CM 表型。摘要未报告样本量、具体统计方法及效应量/95%CI/P 值。
AI.result: JIB-04 可阻止疾病进展，减轻心肌肥厚和纤维化，保护心功能，并在环孢素 A 加速 HCM 模型中完全预防 SCD；还可逆转已建立的疾病，停药后仍有持续获益，并改善老龄自发 HCM 小鼠心功能。RNA-seq 和 ATAC-seq 显示疾病相关转录程序和染色质可及性部分恢复；蛋白组提示 PHF2（KDM7C）为小鼠和人 HCM 心脏中的候选靶点，PHF2 敲低分别抑制心肌细胞肥厚基因、巨噬细胞炎症基因和成纤维细胞纤维化基因表达。人 HCM 心脏中多种 JIB-04 敏感 KDM（包括 PHF2）表达升高；在 MYH7 R403Q iPSC-CM 中，JIB-04 使疾病相关基因表达正常化，恢复 connexin-43 膜定位并改善线粒体呼吸。长期治疗可致可逆性肝大伴肝脂质蓄积，联合抗氧化剂 N-乙酰半胱氨酸可减轻肝毒性并保留疗效。摘要未报告关键统计量。
AI.conclusion: 药理学抑制 KDM 可通过重塑疾病相关转录和染色质程序预防并逆转 HCM，提示 KDM 抑制是潜在治疗策略，PHF2 为候选致病介导因子，支持进一步开发 KDM 靶向治疗。局限性为临床前证据，样本量和统计量未报告，长期肝毒性及人体疗效仍需验证。
